name: Newport County, RI
findings: Newport County has 407 nonprofit organizations. 159 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 133 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Newport County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 16 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
